firmware.title: Amstrad CPC
firmware.author: Mikhail Matveev; Caprice32
firmware.description: An Amstrad CPC 464, 664 and 6128 on Caprice32 with AY sound. Loads DSK and IPF disks, CDT tapes and CPR cartridges.
firmware.controls: PS/2 or USB keyboard, NES/SNES/USB pad. F11: loader, F12 or Select+Start: settings.
